findings.claim: checkImports ignores 'node:test' because 'builtins.has' includes 'node:test' via node:module builtinModules
findings.invariant: new: P-1 claims node:test is rejected, but it is explicitly allowed
findings.title: REFUTE P-1: verify:repo rejects Node's built-in test module

findings.claim: describeProposal omits supersedes and kind fields for decision proposals, hiding critical transition info from the human reviewer
findings.invariant: new: Human reviewer must see all fields of a decision before approval
findings.title: cli-ux: describeProposal silently drops supersedes and kind for DECISION_RECORDED
findings.witness: node --import tsx -e "import { describeProposal } from './src/cli/describe.ts'; console.log(describeProposal({ id: 'p', actor: { kind: 'ai', agent: 'test' }, status: 'PENDING', at: '', item: { kind: 'decision', title: 'T', options: ['A'], selected: 'A', rationale: 'R', supersedes: 'old-decision', kind: 'PROCEED_UNDER_UNCERTAINTY' } }, { claims: [], decisions: [], notes: [] }))"

findings.claim: ProposedItem's 'decision' variant is missing supersedes and kind, making it impossible for AI agents to propose replacing a decision or proceeding under uncertainty
findings.invariant: new: AI proposals must be able to express all valid domain mutations, including decision replacements
findings.title: domain: ProposedItem for decision lacks supersedes and kind
findings.witness: node --import tsx -e "import { z } from 'zod'; import { ProposedItem } from './src/domain/types.ts'; const p: ProposedItem = { kind: 'decision', title: 'A', options: [], selected: 'A', rationale: '', supersedes: 'old' };"

findings.claim: unprocessedNotes only checks state.claims.flatMap(c => c.derivedFrom) to mark notes as used, ignoring state.decisions which can also link notes
findings.invariant: new: Notes used in decisions are processed and should not trigger the unprocessed-notes rule
findings.title: guidance: unprocessed-notes rule ignores notes linked to decisions
findings.witness: node --import tsx -e "import { RULES } from './src/guidance/rules.ts'; console.log(RULES.find(r => r.id === 'unprocessed-notes').evaluate({ notes: [{ id: 'n1', text: 'note', phase: 'EXPLORATION', actor: { kind: 'human' }, at: '' }], claims: [], decisions: [{ id: 'd1', title: 'd', options: [], selected: '', rationale: '', links: ['n1'], phase: 'EXPLORATION', at: '', kind: 'NORMAL', rejected: [] }], proposals: [], phase: 'UNDERSTANDING', id: '', title: '', sessions: [] }, []))"

findings.claim: The isEmpty helper only checks notes, claims, and proposals, meaning a project with only decisions is treated as completely empty
findings.invariant: new: A project with recorded decisions is not empty
findings.title: guidance: isEmpty ignores state.decisions, triggering empty-project incorrectly
findings.witness: node --import tsx -e "import { RULES } from './src/guidance/rules.ts'; console.log(RULES.find(r => r.id === 'empty-project').evaluate({ notes: [], claims: [], proposals: [], decisions: [{ id: 'd1', title: 't', options: [], selected: '', rationale: '', links: [], phase: 'EXPLORATION', at: '', kind: 'NORMAL', rejected: [] }], phase: 'EXPLORATION', id: '', title: '', sessions: [] }, []))"
